batch: Durable multi-operation apply progress and safe continuation

implementation.runManifest: Each scoped _manifest.json now includes ordered per-operation desired state, status, snapshot-presence flag, update time, and failure detail when applicable.
implementation.writes: Manifest updates use a same-directory temporary file and atomic replacement with cleanup of the transient backup.
implementation.errorReport: Failures after a run manifest exists report the RunId, saved operations, completed operations, failed operation, unfinished operations, and recovery command. The catch boundary includes pre-handler package checks and live-state inspection as well as handlers.
implementation.recovery: Restore the reported RunId, review restore warnings, then reapply the same profile from the restored state; the implementation does not retry a potentially drifted partial handler in place. Package presence may be recovered with current upstream when exact-version recovery is unavailable.
implementation.compatibility: Existing snapshot records and restore semantics are unchanged; manifests retain their existing schema version and add an optional progress property.
